entities.name: Oreskos
entities.description: A grassland valley in Theros and the central domain of the leonin, isolated from the human poleis.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where Oreskos lies.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: The dominant people of Oreskos, xenophobic iconoclasts organized in prides led by councils of matriarchs.

entities.name: Archons of Trax
entities.description: Rulers from the north who dominated Theros and enslaved the mortal races until their empire fell.

entities.name: Agnomakhos
entities.description: A leader whose armies conscripted the leonin.

entities.name: Kynaios
entities.description: A human rebel against the archons.

entities.name: Tiro
entities.description: A human rebel against the archons.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A goddess who gifted mortals with magic.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The god of the sun and justice, with a temple atop Mount Kure.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: The wild god honored by some leonin.

entities.name: Brimaz
entities.description: The most recent known speaker of the leonin, who was compleated during the New Phyrexian Invasion and turned on his region.

entities.name: Lanathos
entities.description: A Meletian chronicler, the only human allowed to reside in Tethmos for extended periods.

entities.name: Liala
entities.description: Matron of the Sun Guides.

entities.name: Pyxathor
entities.description: A rival of Brimaz.

entities.name: Seza
entities.description: A friend of both Brimaz and Ajani Goldmane.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who secretly manipulated the leonin into destroying Iretis.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: A god who with Ashiok manipulated the leonin to destroy Iretis.

entities.name: Tethmos
entities.description: The only permanent settlement in Oreskos and its unofficial capital, where matriarchs elect the Speaker.

entities.name: Iretis
entities.description: A small polis near Meletis destroyed by leonin.

entities.name: Mount Kure
entities.description: A sacred mountain in the Katachtons with a golden temple to Heliod.

entities.name: Sun's Mirror
entities.description: A vast placid lake at the center of Oreskos that may show visions.

entities.name: Sun Guides
entities.description: A pride of sages who travel around the Sun's Mirror.

entities.name: Ironmanes
entities.description: A pride of territorial warriors on the western Katachthons who do not recognize the speaker.

entities.name: Swiftclaws
entities.description: A pride of hunters who follow game migration and are poets and storytellers.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Brimaz was compleated.

events.summary: The archons of Trax dominate Theros and conscript the leonin into Agnomakhos's armies.
events.quote: the leonin, in particular, were forcibly conscripted into the armies of Agnomakhos .

events.summary: The leonin lose to the human rebels Kynaios and Tiro after Ephara gifts mortals with magic, and flee to Oreskos when the archon empire falls.
events.quote: As the empire of the archons fell, the leonin fled to Oreskos.

events.summary: Suffering under the archons and feeling abandoned by the gods, the leonin devote themselves to iconoclasm.
events.quote: the leonin devoted themselves to iconoclasm or the rejection of divine worship.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Brimaz is compleated and turns on the region he once ruled.
events.quote: Brimaz was compleated and turned on the region he once ruled.

events.summary: Leonin destroy Iretis through the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax.
events.quote: Destroyed by leonin thanks to the secret manipulations of Ashiok and Phenax

relations.note: He was the most recent known speaker.
relations.quote: The most recently known speaker was Brimaz

relations.note: Oreskos is the leonin's central domain.
relations.quote: Oreskos is a grassland valley in Theros and the central domain of the leonin
Seza , a friend of both Brimaz and Ajani Goldmane
